translations.web: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.
translations.bsb: Behold, My Servant will prosper; He will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.
translations.kjv: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
translations.asv: Behold, my servant shall deal wisely, he shall be exalted and lifted up, and shall be very high.
